{{Infobox auto|title=Prayer of The Light|type=[[Blessing]]}}
The '''Prayer of The Light''' is a [[blessing]], a crafted enchanted book that stores {{MCW|Smite}} IV and {{MCW|Channeling}}. It is crafted from three [[Silver Bullion]], four [[Estus Ash]] and a gold ingot.

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
The book in the center must be a [[Hell-Bound Book]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blessing/channeling_smite.json}}</ref> The crafted item is named "Blessing", with "Prayer of The Light" as a dark gray lore line.

== Usage ==
The Prayer of The Light is applied to equipment in an [[anvil]], like an {{MCW|Enchanted Book|enchanted book}}. Smite applies to weapons and Channeling to tridents. Smite IV is the highest Smite available from a blessing; the [[Prayer of Man]] gives Smite II.

== Trivia ==
* Its internal name is <code>god_king</code>, and it was called the "Prayer of God-King" until {{Version|1.10}}, when the display name changed to "Prayer of The Light" and "Prayer of The God-King" went to the Avesta [[Ofuda]].<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.10|quote=Prayer of God-King, is still labeled as such in the Lang (to preserve update consistency) however the translation was changed to "Prayer of The Light" the Prayer of Ahura Mazda was changed to "Prayer of the God-King"}}</ref>
